summary: 30-foot L-4 pole tower on Frost Peak from 1934, replaced by a treated-timber tower in 1961-62; gone by 1988, with only scraps found in 2025.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives the 1961 tower an R-5 cab; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts call it R-6. Story reports the R-5 and R-6 labels as written.
Forest Lookouts dates the treated-timber tower 1961, Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1961 / 1962, and firelookout.com gives a 1962 completion. Story gives 1961 or 1962.
A 1972 staffer recalls a 40-foot wooden tower; the other sources give 30-foot towers. The record keeps 9.1 m for the 30-foot L-4 and the story reports the staffer's figure as his recollection.

notes_for_editor: The record lists only the L-4 design; the site had a treated-timber replacement in 1961-62 and an interim cupola trailer, so the design field was widened rather than corrected. The record's agency (Coeur d'Alene NF) is correct but partial; Idaho Department of Lands took over operations in 1966. The 2025 visit found scraps and two believed outhouse pits; no source describes any structure remaining. Visit access is drive-up per Idaho Fire Lookouts, with no access rules given.
